Rules.InvariantScript:
Switch(
    ThisItem.'Contract Types',
    'BoP Contract Types'.'Development Contract',
    App.Theme.Colors.Primary,
    'BoP Contract Types'.'Construction Contract',
    ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.neutralQuaternary),
    ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.themeLight)
)

If(
    ThisItem.'BoP Projects Contracts' = locSelectedContract.'BoP Projects Contracts',
    FontWeight.Semibold,
    FontWeight.Normal
)

If(
    ThisItem.'Contract Types' = 'BoP Contract Types'.'Project Rights Contract',
    con_Contracts_List_Card_Body_Fields_TotalCosts_RC.Height,
    con_Contracts_List_Card_Body_Fields_CostsUntilClosing.Height + con_Contracts_List_Card_Body_Fields_Margins.Height
)
Not(ThisItem.'Contract Types'= 'BoP Contract Types'.'Project Rights Contract')
"Costs Until Closing [" & If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "EUR") & "]"

        ThisItem.'Costs After Closing Date [EUR]' = 'Closing Date Type'.Plan,

            0,
            ThisItem.'Costs After Closing Date Plan'
        ),
        If(
            IsBlank(ThisItem.'Costs After Closing Date Actual'),
            0,
            ThisItem.'Costs After Closing Date Actual'
        )
    ),
    "###,##0"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedContract)),
    locSelectedContract.'Costs Until Closing Date Actual'
)

If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    gblAppResx.Numeric,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "###,###"
    )}"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    $"Input must not be blank",
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    $"Numeric value with no decimals",
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value,
                0,
                10000000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        10000000,
        "###,###"
    )}"
)

    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedContract)),

)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    gblAppResx.Numeric,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "#,##0"
    )}"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    $"Input must not be blank",
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    $"Numeric value with no decimals",
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate_Plan.Value,
                0,
                10000000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        10000000,
        "#,##0"
    )}"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedContract)),
    locSelectedContract.'Costs After Closing Date Actual'
)

If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    gblAppResx.Numeric,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "###,###"
    )}"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    $"Input must not be blank",
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
    $"Numeric value with no decimals",
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Actual.Value,
                0,
                10000000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        10000000,
        "###,###"
    )}",
    "##"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedContract)),
    locSelectedContract.'Costs After Closing Date Plan'
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    gblAppResx.Numeric,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "###,###"
    )}"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    $"Input must not be blank",
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsInteger(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
    $"Numeric value with no decimals",
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsAfterClosingDate_Plan.Value,
                0,
                10000000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        10000000,
        "###,###"
    )}",
    "##"
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedContract)),
        Not(locContractDevCoCostsCahnged)
    ),
    locSelectedContract.'Margin Fixed Value',
    locSelectedContractMarginFixedValues
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginFixedValues.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsTwoDecimal(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginFixedValues.Value)),
    gblAppResx.NumericTwoDecimals,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginFixedValues.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginFixedValues.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "###,###0,00"
    )}"
)

If(
    And(
        rad_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Projects Contracts)'.Yes,
        rad_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginType.Selected.Value = 'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage
    ),
    80,
    0
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginPercentage.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_Contracts.IsOneDecimal(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginPercentage.Value)),
    gblAppResx.NumericOneDecimals,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginPercentage.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Contracts.InRange(
                txt_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_MarginPercentage.Value,
                0,
                100
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        100,
        "###,###0.0"
    )}"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    !IsBlank(locSelectedContract.'Margin Type'),
    If(
        rad_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Projects Contracts)'.Yes,
        Filter(
            Choices('Contract Margin Type'),
            ThisRecord.Value = If(
                !locIsStandardAssumtions,
                locSelectedContract.'Margin Type',
                locStandardAssumptionMarginTypeFabric = Text('Contract Margin Type'.Percentage),
                'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage,
                'Contract Margin Type'.'Fixed Value'
            )
        )
    ),
    Filter(
        Choices('Contract Margin Type'),
        ThisRecord.Value = 'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    IsBlank(locSelectedContract),
    If(
        rad_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Projects Contracts)'.Yes,
        Filter(
            Choices('Contract Margin Type'),
            ThisRecord.Value = If(
                !IsBlank(locStandardAssumptionMarginType),
                locStandardAssumptionMarginType,
                IsBlank(locStandardAssumptionMarginTypeFabric),
                'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage,
                locStandardAssumptionMarginTypeFabric = Text('Contract Margin Type'.Percentage),
                'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage,
                'Contract Margin Type'.'Fixed Value'
            )
        )
    ),
    Filter(
        Choices('Contract Margin Type'),
        ThisRecord.Value = locSelectedContract.'Margin Type'
    )
)
